name: Accessibility Scanner
description: Discovers the active target application's accessibility root and elements.
permissions: Android Accessibility Service must be enabled by the user.
inputs: Configured target package name; current accessibility-service state.
outputs: Active accessibility root for the target package, or null when unavailable.

configuration.targetPackage: required by configurable constructor; defaults to com.openai.chatgpt for backward compatibility

limits: Scan only reports nodes exposed by the current active accessibility window.
tests: Target-package filtering and unavailable-root tests are pending; manual device verification is required.
limitations: Available nodes and properties depend on the target application and Android version.
Package-specific filtering belongs in configuration or an adapter, not in a project-neutral scanner core.
